places.name: Kheerganga Trek
places.description: The iconic Parvati Valley overnight trek — forest trail, sacred hot spring, and sublime mountain camping combined.
places.mapsSearch: Kheerganga Trek, Parvati Valley, Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: May to June and September to November; avoid monsoon (July-August) for safety.

places.name: Parvati River Walk
places.description: The soul of Kasol — a meditative riverside walk through pine forest beside one of Himachal's most beautiful mountain rivers.
places.mapsSearch: Parvati River Kasol, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: April to June and September to November.

places.name: Chalal Village Walk
places.description: A glimpse of authentic pre-tourism Parvati Valley village life, reachable in minutes from Kasol's guesthouses.
places.bestTime: April to June and September to October.

places.name: Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara
places.description: A living miracle of geography and faith — boiling natural springs cook the community meal, watched by pilgrims from across India.
places.mapsSearch: Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara, Manikaran, Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: Year-round; Baisakhi (April) draws the largest Sikh pilgrimage crowds.

places.name: Pin Parvati Pass Trek
places.description: A legendary Himalayan crossing that traverses two completely different worlds — lush Kullu and barren Spiti.
places.mapsSearch: Pin Parvati Pass Trek, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: July to September only, when snow conditions allow passage.

places.name: Tosh Village and Tosh Glacier
places.description: The best viewpoint in the Parvati Valley area — a high village with a dramatic glacier backdrop and genuine mountain solitude.
places.bestTime: May to October for the glacier trail; winter (December-February) for snow but road access may be cut.

places.name: Grahan Village Trek
places.description: A far quieter, more authentic alternative to the Kheerganga crowds — genuine village trekking with exceptional forest.
places.mapsSearch: Grahan Village Trek Kasol, Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: May to June and September to November.

places.name: Kasol Main Market and Cafes
places.description: India's most cosmopolitan hill-village market — the place to recover from a trek over shakshuka and strong filter coffee.
places.mapsSearch: Kasol Main Market, Kasol, Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: Evening for the full social atmosphere; morning for fresh Israeli baking.

places.name: Barsheni and Pulga Hamlet
places.description: The authentic 'end of the road' experience — a remote hamlet with valley views and the feel of the real Himalayas.
places.mapsSearch: Pulga Village Parvati Valley, Himachal Pradesh
places.bestTime: May to November; road to Barsheni may close in heavy snowfall.

places.name: Rasol Village Trek
places.description: Kasol's best-kept secret — a totally isolated mountain village with top-of-valley views and zero crowds.

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
